analysis: The trial succeeded with host validation macro HR@10 of 0.5887: Movies_and_TV 0.625, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.650, Electronics 0.445, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.635. Electronics was the weakest category. Allocated GPU time was 1,288.42 seconds. The result confirms successful training and predictor execution, but without standalone expert scores or a baseline comparison, it does not establish that fusion or prefix reconstruction improved accuracy. Checkpoints were selected independently for each expert, so selection did not directly optimize the fused score.
code_summary: Retained four dataset-specific model pairs and explicit dataset routing. Each pair combines a two-block SASRec trained with sampled positive/negative logistic loss and a residual MultVAE trained with normalized multinomial reconstruction plus annealed KL loss. VAE batches mix whole-history denoising with 30% chronological prefix-to-future reconstruction. Each expert selects its checkpoint using fixed validation candidates and HR@10, with NDCG breaking ties. Inference combines candidate ranks using equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with offset 60. The generated predictor imports the training architecture and loads both checkpoints, preserving training/inference preprocessing consistency.
